title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：microscope　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 microscope 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the researcher ① used the microscope that no student in the lab would have counted, and he said the using was the whole of the term. The ② microscope, meaning the instrument itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed uncounted in the book; a microscope, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ microscope in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ microscope at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A microscope, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the researcher said the counting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the microscope was the whole of the matter, meaning the vision and not the instrument. The ⑥ microscope, meaning the vision and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; microscope, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both an instrument and a vision. He said the vision is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ microscope had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ microscope of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of counting; microscope, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ microscope I remember is the instrument counted in the paper, which closed in 1991 and is still counted as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ microscope, my mother said in 1993, is the only instrument that improves by being counted; every microscope, she said, is a vision that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the vision was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 显微镜（指实验室里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 显微镜（指那台显微镜本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the microscope 用这一台显微镜
D. n. 显微镜（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 显微镜之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的显微镜之事）
F. n. 显微镜（指研究报告里写到、被清点的那一台）
G. n. 显微镜、眼界（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 眼界（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the microscope that no student in the lab would have counted
The microscope, meaning the instrument itself and not the tube
the microscope at the far bench
the microscope was the whole of the matter
the microscope had become a line in a paper
The microscope of the whole thing
A microscope, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: use the microscope 意为“用这一台显微镜”，1984 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯清点的一台显微镜做了一遍。
microscope 意为“显微镜”，指那台显微镜本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。
microscope 意为“显微镜”，指实验室里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
microscope 意为“显微镜”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
microscope 意为“显微镜、眼界”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台眼界就是那件事的全部。
microscope 意为“眼界”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台显微镜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
microscope 意为“显微镜”，指研究报告里写到、被清点的那一台，到 1989 年这一台成了研究报告里的一行。
microscope 意为“显微镜之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的显微镜之事是一处实验室和三个学期的清点。
microscope 意为“显微镜”，我记得的是研究报告里清点过的那一台，1991 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一台。
microscope 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，显微镜是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的显微镜。
